places.name: Amber Fort
places.description: The grandest Rajput fort in India, with a Sheesh Mahal that transforms candlelight into a galaxy of stars.
places.bestTime: October to March; early morning for elephant rides

places.name: Hawa Mahal
places.description: The most photographed facade in Rajasthan and a masterpiece of latticed sandstone craftsmanship.
places.bestTime: October to March; sunrise for the pink glow

places.name: City Palace
places.description: A living royal complex where Rajput heritage and royal family tradition coexist within a remarkable museum.

places.name: Jantar Mantar
places.description: The world's largest and most precise 18th-century stone observatory, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

places.name: Nahargarh Fort
places.description: Jaipur's finest sunset viewpoint, with rampart views over the entire Pink City and a unique royal zenana complex.

places.name: Jaigarh Fort
places.description: Home to the world's largest cannon and the finest military fort architecture in the Jaipur triangle of hilltop forts.

places.name: Albert Hall Museum
places.description: Rajasthan's finest 19th-century Indo-Saracenic museum building, with an eclectic collection that includes an Egyptian mummy.
places.mapsSearch: Albert Hall Museum, Jaipur, Rajasthan, India

places.name: Johri Bazaar and Old City Markets
places.description: The most comprehensive traditional bazaar experience in India, a living gem-trading and textile city.
places.bestTime: October to March; avoid Monday (many shops closed)

places.name: Jal Mahal
places.description: Jaipur's most whimsically romantic landmark — a Mughal palace seemingly afloat on a mountain lake.
places.bestTime: October to March; sunrise and sunset

places.name: Birla Mandir (Laxmi Narayan Temple)
places.description: Jaipur's most luminous marble temple, glowing at the base of Moti Dungri Hill like a white beacon.

budget.label: Budget
budget.blurb: Hostels or guesthouses, local food, public transport

midRange.label: Mid-range
midRange.blurb: Three-star hotels, a mix of restaurants, the odd taxi

comfortable.label: Comfortable
comfortable.blurb: Good four-star stays, restaurants by choice, tours
